comparison.objective: Rotate a guarded blank to a marked angle while keeping it centered.
comparison.physical_skill: Use two push tools outside a guard to apply coordinated tangential forces.
comparison.success_condition: Target angle and centering with no gripper entering the guard; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both use two tools and force regulation, this tests guarded in-plane rotation and centering, not impact-driven notch fracture and loose-fragment containment.
